Next, find the partial derivative of \( P \) with respect to \( y \): \( \frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(x^2) = 0 \).
Therefore, \( \frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 0 - 0 = 0 \).
